newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Romania seeks to boost trade with Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Romania seeks to boost trade with Indonesia.

text.p: Romanian President Emil Constantinescu arrived in Jakarta on Thursday for a three-day visit to discuss economic and trade relations between the two countries.
"The visit by the Romanian president is expected to expand economic ties and boost trade," State Secretary Murdiono told reporters.
Constantinescu was scheduled to hold official talks with President Suharto on Friday.
He will visit the central Java city of Yogyakarta and the resort island of Bali on Saturday before returning to Romania.
